propositions: normalize_ci_conclusion.sh must be ported from shell to a stdlib-only Python entry point while preserving the exact f(CONCLUSION, FAILURE_OBSERVED) -> {success, failure, cancelled} contract
The existing subprocess-driven contract test must be re-pointed to invoke the new Python entry point instead of the shell script, with the full case table preserved
The gerrit-verify.yaml workflow must update its sparse-checkout path from scripts/normalize_ci_conclusion.sh to the new Python file and update the run invocation accordingly
Direct unit tests must be added to cover the function contract including skipped-fallback rows, fail-closed empty/unknown rows, and both FAILURE_OBSERVED values for pass-through rows
The Python entry point must be dependency-free and single-file-executable so sparse-checkout of only the .py file can run it without package installation
The shell script must be deleted in the same change so no test references an orphaned file
